name: Hinadori no Saezuri
source:
Hinadori no Saezuri is a simulation game with touches of strategy. The game is set in a pseudo-historical scenery that resembles the Victorian era in Europe. The player is cast into the role of Foster, a manager of a large mansion. The owner is a young lady named Carol, daughter of the late baron who was successfully running a brothel in it, until it was burnt down. Now the house is rebuilt, and the business can start again. Carol entrusts Foster with teaching and managing the work of the maids, who double as hostesses and prostitutes. What is meant by "teaching" is actually training in all things related to sex. 

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/hinadori-no-saezuri]Mobygames[/url]]
translation:
《雏鸟之新精》是一款带有策略色彩的模拟游戏。游戏以类似欧洲维多利亚时代的伪历史场景为背景。玩家扮演福斯特的角色，是一座大宅邸的经理。店主是一位名叫卡罗尔的年轻女士，是已故男爵的女儿，她在里面成功地经营着一家妓院，直到它被烧毁。现在房子已经重建好了，生意也可以重新开始了。卡罗尔委托福斯特教导和管理女仆的工作，女仆兼任女主人和妓女。所谓“教”，实际上是指一切与性有关的事情的训练。

[来自[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/hinadori-no-saezuri]Mobygames[/url]]
